jobs.description:
An der Universität Bern werden jährlich drei Lehrstellen als Polymechaniker/in EFZ neu besetzt. Die Ausbildung wird an den drei Instituten Physikalisches Institut, ARTORG und DCBP angeboten.
Ausbildung
Während der ersten Lehrhälfte wird in der Grundausbildung ein breites Fundament an Wissen und Können gelegt. In der Werkstatt werden Arbeitstechniken wie manuelle und maschinelle Fertigungstechnik, Montagetechnik, Fügetechnik, Wartung und fachspezifische Arbeitssicherheit vermittelt. In der erweiterten Grundausbildung werden die verschiedenen Arbeitstechniken durch exemplarisches Lernen an und Projekten vertieft. Die Schwerpunktausbildung erfolgt in der zweiten Lehrhälfte. In dieser Ausbildungsphase wird die Bedienung und Programmierung von CNC-gesteuerten Werkzeugmaschinen vermittelt. In einem Konstruktionspraktikum erfolgt der Einblick in die Konstruktions- und CAD-Technik.
Die 
• Anforderungen
Gesucht werden motivierte, gute Sekundar- oder sehr gute Realschüler/innen mit sehr guten Kenntnissen in Mathematik und Physik. Zudem sind Interesse an technischen Zusammenhängen, handwerkliches Geschick, gutes räumliches Vorstellungsvermögen sowie eine exakte und selbständige Arbeitsweise gefragt. Ausdauer, Durchhaltevermögen, Geduld und Zuverlässigkeit sindebenso wichtige Eigenschaften. Der Beruf bedingt, dass du frei von Allergien auf Metalle, Öle und Fette bist.
Die Schnupperlehre
Die Schnupperlehre bietet dir die Möglichkeit, den Beruf des Polymechanikers sowie die Institute ARTORG, DCBP und das Physikalische Institut näher kennenzulernen und erste Erfahrungen in der Arbeitswelt zu sammeln. Die Schnupperlehre wird von Januar bis Juni, jeweils von Montag bis Mittwoch, angeboten.
Bewerbungen für eine Schnupperlehre

descriptionByLocale.it:
I tre istituti dell'Istituto di Fisica, ARTORG e DCBP offrono la formazione. Compiti: Durante la prima metà del corso, si pone un'ampia base sulle conoscenze e sulle competenze. In officina vengono insegnate tecniche di lavoro come la tecnologia di fabbricazione manuale e meccanica, la tecnologia di assemblaggio, l'unione di tecnologia, la manutenzione e la sicurezza specialistica. Nella formazione di base estesa, le varie tecniche di lavoro sono approfondite da ex-studi e progetti. La formazione principale è nella seconda metà dell'apprendistato. Durante questa fase di formazione, il funzionamento e la programmazione di macchine utensili controllati CNC è insegnato. In uno stage di progettazione, la comprensione del design e la tecnologia CAD è fornita.
• Requisiti: Motivated, buon Sekundar o molto buoni studenti reali con una buona conoscenza della matematica e della fisica sono ricercati. Inoltre, l'interesse per i rapporti tecnici, l'artigianalità, la buona immaginazione spaziale e un metodo di lavoro preciso e indipendente sono necessarie. Perseveranza, perseveranza, pazienza e affidabilità sono anche caratteristiche importanti. La professione richiede che tu sia privo di allergie ai metalli, oli e grassi.
• Offriamo: L'apprendistato ti offre l'opportunità di conoscere la professione di polimeccanica così come gli istituti ARTORG, DCBP e il physikalische Institut e di acquisire le prime esperienze nel mondo del lavoro. L'apprendistato è offerto da gennaio a giugno, da lunedì a mercoledì.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The three institutes of the Institute of Physics, ARTORG and DCBP offer the training. Tasks: During the first half of the course, a broad foundation is laid on knowledge and skills. In the workshop, work techniques such as manual and machine manufacturing technology, assembly technology, joining technology, maintenance and specialist safety are taught. In the extended basic training, the various working techniques are deepened by ex-studies and projects. The main training is in the second half of the apprenticeship. During this training phase, the operation and programming of CNC-controlled machine tools is taught. In a design internship, the insight into the design and CAD technology is provided.
• Requirements: Motivated, good Sekundar or very good real students with very good knowledge of mathematics and physics are sought. In addition, interest in technical relationships, craftsmanship, good spatial imagination and an exact and independent working method are required. Perseverance, perseverance, patience and reliability are also important characteristics. The profession requires that you are free of allergies to metals, oils and fats.
• We offer: The apprenticeship offers you the opportunity to get to know the profession of polymechanics as well as the institutes ARTORG, DCBP and the Physikalische Institut and to gain first experiences in the world of work. The apprenticeship is offered from January to June, from Monday to Wednesday.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
À l'Université de Berne, trois apprentissages sont remplis chaque année en tant que polymécanicien/en EFZ. La formation est offerte dans les trois instituts de physique, ARTORG et DCBP.
Formation
Au cours de la première moitié de l'enseignement, un large socle de connaissances et de compétences est posé dans la formation de base. Au cours de l'atelier, des techniques de travail telles que la technologie de production manuelle et mécanique, la technologie d'assemblage, la technologie d'assemblage, la maintenance et la sécurité au travail spécifique sont enseignées. Dans le cadre de la formation de base étendue, les différentes techniques de travail sont approfondies par des apprentissages et des projets exemplaires. La formation ciblée a lieu dans la seconde moitié de l'enseignement. Dans cette phase de formation, on enseigne le fonctionnement et la programmation des machines-outils contrôlées par CNC. Dans le cadre d'un stage de conception, la connaissance de la conception et de la technologie CAO a lieu.
Les
• Exigences
Nous sommes à la recherche d'étudiants motivés, bon secondaire ou très bon réel avec de très bonnes connaissances en mathématiques et en physique. De plus, il faut s'intéresser aux connexions techniques, à l'artisanat, à une bonne imagination spatiale et à une méthode de travail exacte et indépendante. L'endurance, la persévérance, la patience et la fiabilité sont des caractéristiques tout aussi importantes. La profession exige que vous soyez exempts d'allergies aux métaux, aux huiles et aux graisses.
La théorie du procès
L'apprentissage d'essai vous offre la possibilité de connaître la profession de polymécanique ainsi que les instituts ARTORG, DCBP et l'Institut physique et d'acquérir une expérience initiale dans le monde du travail. L'apprentissage d'essai est offert de janvier à juin, du lundi au mercredi.

jobs.description:
UniBE is ambitious.
With us, you deliver top performance and test your skills against the best.

## What You Can Expect
You will join an active, supportive, inclusive, and collaborative research environment at the Department of Mathematics and Statistics. You will work on exciting fundamental questions at the interface of mathematics and modern AI and collaborate with national and international researchers. You will also contribute to teaching as a teaching assistant.
Employment conditions and remuneration are in accordance with the standards of the University of Bern, Switzerland.

## Profile of the Candidate
Applicants should hold, or be close to completing, a Master's degree in pure or applied mathematics, theoretical physics, statistics, or a related field.
We seek motivated candidates with a strong background in mathematics (e.g., in one or more of the following areas: analysis, probability theory, stochastic processes, statistical physics, optimal transport, dynamical systems, optimization, or machine learning theory), an interest in the mathematical principles underlying modern AI (or in related problems), the ability to work both independently and collaboratively, and good written and spoken English. Knowledge of German is not required. Programming experience is beneficial but not required.
International reputation
Application and Contact
Applications should include:
• a motivation letter (maximum one page);
• a curriculum vitae (maximum two pages);
• available BSc/MSc diplomas or academic transcripts;
• the names and contact details of one or two referees; and
• optional: a summary of the master's thesis (maximum two pages)
Evaluation of applications will continue until the position is filled. The exact starting date will be agreed upon with the successful candidate.

## About the Project
Modern artificial intelligence systems achieve remarkable performance, yet the mathematical mechanisms underlying their behavior remain only partially understood. This project seeks to develop a rigorous theory of modern learning algorithms and to explain how their architecture and dynamics determine their performance.
Depending on their background and interests, the candidate will use tools from analysis, probability theory, stochastic processes, statistical physics, dynamical systems, optimization, and optimal transport to prove mathematical results describing the behavior of modern learning algorithms in suitable abstract settings. Possible research directions include training dynamics and signal propagation in deep neural networks, including transformers; generative modeling; high-dimensional learning systems; sampling algorithms; collective phenomena in large-scale models; and quantum algorithms.
The work will be primarily theoretical. Computational experiments may be used to guide conjectures and illustrate theoretical results, depending on the candidate's interests.

descriptionByLocale.it:
UniBE è ambizioso.
Con noi, si offre le migliori prestazioni e testare le vostre abilità contro il meglio.

## Cosa si può aspettare
Ti unirai ad un ambiente di ricerca attivo, di supporto, inclusivo e collaborativo presso il Dipartimento di Matematica e Statistica. Si lavorerà su questioni fondamentali entusiasmanti all'interfaccia della matematica e dell'intelligenza artificiale moderna e collaborare con i ricercatori nazionali e internazionali. Contribuirai anche all'insegnamento come assistente di insegnamento.
Le condizioni di lavoro e la remunerazione sono conformi alle norme dell'Università di Berna, Svizzera.

## Profilo del candidato
I candidati devono tenere, o essere vicino al completamento, un master in matematica pura o applicata, fisica teorica, statistiche, o un campo correlato.
Cerchiamo candidati motivati con un forte background in matematica (ad esempio, in una o più delle seguenti aree: analisi, teoria delle probabilità, processi stocastici, fisica statistica, trasporto ottimale, sistemi dinamici, ottimizzazione, o teoria dell'apprendimento automatico), un interesse per i principi matematici sottostanti AI moderno (o in problemi correlati), la capacità di lavorare sia in modo indipendente e collaborativo, e buon inglese scritto e parlato. La conoscenza del tedesco non è richiesta. L'esperienza di programmazione è utile ma non richiesto.
reputazione internazionale
Applicazione e contatto
Le domande devono includere:
• una lettera di motivazione (massimo una pagina);
• un curriculum vitae (massimo due pagine);
• disponibili diplomi BSc/MSc o trascrizioni accademiche;
• i nomi e i dettagli di contatto di uno o due arbitri; e
• opzionale: un riassunto della tesi del maestro (massimo due pagine)
La revisione delle applicazioni inizierà nell'ultima settimana di agosto 2026 e continuerà fino a quando la posizione sarà riempita. La prima possibile data di inizio è ottobre 2026. La data di partenza esatta sarà concordata con il candidato di successo.

## Informazioni sul progetto
I moderni sistemi di intelligenza artificiale ottengono prestazioni notevoli, ma i meccanismi matematici sottostanti il loro comportamento rimangono solo parzialmente compresi. Questo progetto mira a sviluppare una rigorosa teoria degli algoritmi di apprendimento moderni e a spiegare come la loro architettura e dinamica determinano le loro prestazioni.
A seconda del loro background e interessi, il candidato utilizzerà strumenti da analisi, teoria delle probabilità, processi stocastici, fisica statistica, sistemi dinamici, ottimizzazione e trasporto ottimale per dimostrare risultati matematici che descrivono il comportamento degli algoritmi di apprendimento moderni in impostazioni astratti adeguate. Possibili direzioni di ricerca includono la dinamica di formazione e la propagazione del segnale nelle reti neurali profonde, compresi i trasformatori; la modellazione generativa; sistemi di apprendimento ad alta dimensione; algoritmi di campionamento; fenomeni collettivi nei modelli su larga scala; e algoritmi quantistici.
Il lavoro sarà principalmente teorico. Gli esperimenti computazionali possono essere utilizzati per guidare le congetture e illustrare i risultati teorici, a seconda degli interessi del candidato.

UniBE is ambitious.
With us, you deliver top performance and test your skills against the best.

## What You Can Expect
You will join an active, supportive, inclusive, and collaborative research environment at the Department of Mathematics and Statistics. You will work on exciting fundamental questions at the interface of mathematics and modern AI and collaborate with national and international researchers. You will also contribute to teaching as a teaching assistant.
Employment conditions and remuneration are in accordance with the standards of the University of Bern, Switzerland.

## Profile of the Candidate
Applicants should hold, or be close to completing, a Master's degree in pure or applied mathematics, theoretical physics, statistics, or a related field.
We seek motivated candidates with a strong background in mathematics (e.g., in one or more of the following areas: analysis, probability theory, stochastic processes, statistical physics, optimal transport, dynamical systems, optimization, or machine learning theory), an interest in the mathematical principles underlying modern AI (or in related problems), the ability to work both independently and collaboratively, and good written and spoken English. Knowledge of German is not required. Programming experience is beneficial but not required.
International reputation
Application and Contact
Applications should include:
• a motivation letter (maximum one page);
• a curriculum vitae (maximum two pages);
• available BSc/MSc diplomas or academic transcripts;
• the names and contact details of one or two referees; and
• optional: a summary of the master's thesis (maximum two pages)
Evaluation of applications will continue until the position is filled. The exact starting date will be agreed upon with the successful candidate.

## About the Project
Modern artificial intelligence systems achieve remarkable performance, yet the mathematical mechanisms underlying their behavior remain only partially understood. This project seeks to develop a rigorous theory of modern learning algorithms and to explain how their architecture and dynamics determine their performance.
Depending on their background and interests, the candidate will use tools from analysis, probability theory, stochastic processes, statistical physics, dynamical systems, optimization, and optimal transport to prove mathematical results describing the behavior of modern learning algorithms in suitable abstract settings. Possible research directions include training dynamics and signal propagation in deep neural networks, including transformers; generative modeling; high-dimensional learning systems; sampling algorithms; collective phenomena in large-scale models; and quantum algorithms.
The work will be primarily theoretical. Computational experiments may be used to guide conjectures and illustrate theoretical results, depending on the candidate's interests.

Sie werden einer aktiven, unterstützenden, integrativen und kollaborativen Forschungsumgebung an der Abteilung für Mathematik und Statistik beitreten. B. in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche: Analyse, Wahrscheinlichkeitstheorie, stochastische Prozesse, statistische Physik, optimaler Transport, dynamische Systeme, Optimierung oder maschinelle Lerntheorie), ein Interesse an den mathematischen Prinzipien, die der modernen KI zugrunde liegen (oder an verwandten Problemen), die Fähigkeit, sowohl unabhängig als auch kollaborativ zu arbeiten, und gutes geschriebenes und gesprochenes Englisch. Moderne Systeme der künstlichen Intelligenz erreichen eine bemerkenswerte Leistung, doch die mathematischen Mechanismen, die ihrem Verhalten zugrunde liegen, bleiben nur teilweise verstanden. Dieses Projekt zielt darauf ab, eine strenge Theorie moderner Lernalgorithmen zu entwickeln und zu erklären, wie ihre Architektur und Dynamik ihre Leistung bestimmen.

Die Arbeit wird in erster Linie theoretisch sein. Computerexperimente können verwendet werden, um Vermutungen zu leiten und theoretische Ergebnisse zu veranschaulichen, abhängig von den Interessen des Kandidaten.

jobs.description:
UniBE is interconnected.
With us, you're part of an international community and benefit from interdisciplinary collaboration.

## Tasks
• Establish, characterise and maintain patient-derived cancer cell lines and 3D organoids, including models derived prospectively from fresh tumour biopsies
• Perform in vitro efficacy studies and mechanistic validation experiments, using drug response, clonogenic growth and live-cell imaging assays
• Design and carry out genome-wide CRISPR/Cas9 synthetic lethality screens and validate the resulting druggable hits
• Analyse screening and sequencing data using established bioinformatics pipelines (MAGeCK RRA/MLE, R)
• Perform confocal and multiplexed immunofluorescence microscopy
• Contribute to in vivo xenograft experiments and to the histological and computational pathology characterisation of explanted tumours
• Present results at national and international conferences and prepare first-author manuscripts for peer-reviewed journals
• Participate in the doctoral programme of the Graduate School for Cellular and Biomedical Sciences

## Your Profile
• Master's degree (MSc) in Molecular Life Sciences (Cell and Molecular Biology or Biochemistry/Chemical Biology), Biomedical Sciences, molecular biology, biochemistry, biotechnology or a related field, completed by the starting date, ideally with at least one full year lab experience.
• Solid practical experience in mammalian cell culture (experience with 3D organoids is an advantage)
• Experience in standard molecular biology and imaging techniques (western blotting, immunofluorescence, qPCR, optical microscopy). Experience with confocal microscopy is an advantage
• Basic skills in data analysis and statistics; familiarity with GraphPad or R is an advantage
• Strong motivation for translational cancer research and genuine interest in bridging laboratory work and clinical questions
• Ability to work collaboratively within an interdisciplinary and multicentric team
• Excellent command of English, written and spoken
Strong research infrastructure and international network
Application and Contact
With us, you create value.
For yourself and for society.

## Project description
Our laboratory work focuses on molecularly targeted treatment strategies for solid tumours, exploiting DNA repair alterations as therapeutic vulnerabilities to advance precision oncology. In previous work, using a genome-wide CRISPR/Cas9 screen and a high-throughput drug screen, we recently identified Aurora kinase A (AURKA) as a synthetic lethal target in cancers deficient in FANCA, the most frequently altered gene of the Fanconi anaemia DNA repair pathway. The proposed PhD project, will advance the preclinical validation of this newly uncovered vulnerability in clinically relevant patient-derived cancer models and in vivo, identify synergistic targets for combination therapies through functional genomic screening, and characterise the tumour immune microenvironment of Fanconi anaemia pathway-deficient cancers in order to nominate synergistic immunotherapy targets. The position is embedded in an interdisciplinary and multicentric team of medical oncologists, pathologists and basic and translational researchers. The PhD candidate will be enrolled in the Graduate School for Cellular and Biomedical Sciences of the University of Bern.

## Compiti
• Stabilire, caratterizzare e mantenere le linee delle cellule tumorali del paziente e i organoidi 3D, compresi i modelli derivati prospetticamente da biopsie tumorali fresche
• Eseguire studi di efficacia in vitro e esperimenti di convalida meccanistica, utilizzando la risposta alla droga, la crescita clonogenica e analisi di imaging a cellule vive
• Progettare e realizzare schermi di letalità sintetici CRISPR/Cas9 in tutto il genoma e convalidare i risultati dei risultati
• Analizzare i dati di screening e di sequenziamento mediante condotte di bioinformatica consolidate (MAGeCK RRA/MLE, R)
• Esegui microscopia confocale e multiplexed immunofluorescence
• Contribuire a esperimenti di xenograft in vivo e alla caratterizzazione istologica e computazionale di tumori espiantati
• Risultati attuali a conferenze nazionali e internazionali e preparare manoscritti di primo autore per riviste peer-reviewed
• Partecipa al programma di dottorato della Scuola di Laurea per le Scienze Cellulari e Biomedicali

## Il tuo profilo
• Laurea Magistrale (MSc) in Scienze della Vita Molecolare (Biologia Cellulare e Molecolare o Biochimica/Biologia Chimica), Scienze Biomedicali, Biologia molecolare, Biochimica, Biotecnologia o un campo correlato, completato dalla data di inizio, idealmente con almeno un'esperienza di laboratorio di tutto l'anno.
• Solida esperienza pratica nella cultura cellulare mammifero (l'esperienza con organoidi 3D è un vantaggio)
• Esperienza nella biologia molecolare standard e nelle tecniche di imaging (blotting occidentale, immunofluorescence, qPCR, microscopia ottica). L'esperienza con la microscopia confocale è un vantaggio
• Competenze di base nell'analisi dei dati e nelle statistiche; la familiarità con GraphPad o R è un vantaggio
• Forte motivazione per la ricerca traduttiva sul cancro e l'interesse genuino nel corroborare il lavoro di laboratorio e le domande cliniche
• Capacità di lavorare collaborativamente in un team interdisciplinare e multicentrico
• Ottimo comando di inglese, scritto e parlato
Forte infrastruttura di ricerca e rete internazionale
Applicazione e contatto
Con noi, crei valore.
Per te e per la società.

## Descrizione del progetto
Il nostro lavoro di laboratorio si concentra sulle strategie di trattamento mirate molecolare per tumori solidi, sfruttando le alterazioni della riparazione del DNA come vulnerabilità terapeutiche per avanzare l'oncologia di precisione. Nel lavoro precedente, utilizzando uno schermo CRISPR/Cas9 a livello di genoma e uno schermo di droga ad alto rendimento, abbiamo recentemente identificato Aurora kinase A (AURKA) come obiettivo letale sintetico nei tumori carenti in FANCA, il gene più frequentemente alterato del percorso di riparazione del DNA dell'anemia Fanconi. Il progetto PhD proposto, progrederà la validazione preclinica di questa vulnerabilità appena scoperta nei modelli di cancro clinicamente rilevanti e in vivo, identificherà gli obiettivi sinergici per le terapie combinate attraverso lo screening genomico funzionale, e caratterizzerà il microambiente immunitario del tumore Fanconi anaemia pathway-deficient per nominare obiettivi di immunoterapia sinergici. La posizione è incorporata in un team interdisciplinare e multicentrico di oncologi medici, patologi e ricercatori di base e di traduzione. Il Dottorato di Ricerca sarà iscritto alla Graduate School for Cellular and Biomedical Sciences dell'Università di Berna.

• Master-Abschluss (MSc) in Molekularen Biowissenschaften (Zell- und Molekularbiologie oder Biochemie / Chemiebiologie), Biomedizinische Wissenschaften, Molekularbiologie, Biochemie, Biotechnologie oder einem verwandten Bereich, zum Startdatum abgeschlossen, idealerweise mit mindestens einem ganzen Jahr Laborerfahrung.

## Projektbeschreibung
Unsere Laborarbeit konzentriert sich auf molekular zielgerichtete Behandlungsstrategien für solide Tumoren und nutzt DNA-Reparaturänderungen als therapeutische Schwachstellen, um die Präzisionsonkologie voranzutreiben. In früheren Arbeiten mit einem genomweiten CRISPR / Cas9-Bildschirm und einem Hochdurchsatz-Medikamenten-Bildschirm haben wir kürzlich Aurora-Kinase A (AURKA) als synthetisches tödliches Ziel bei Krebsarten identifiziert, die an FANCA, dem am häufigsten veränderten Gen des Fanconi-Anämie-DNA-Reparaturwegs, mangelhaft sind. Das vorgeschlagene PhD-Projekt wird die präklinische Validierung dieser neu entdeckten Vulnerabilität in klinisch relevanten patientenabgeleiteten Krebsmodellen und in vivo vorantreiben, synergistische Ziele für Kombinationstherapien durch funktionelles genomisches Screening identifizieren und die Tumorimmunmikroumgebung von Fanconi-Anämie-Weg-defizienten Krebsarten charakterisieren, um synergistische Immuntherapieziele zu nominieren. Die Position ist eingebettet in ein interdisziplinäres und multizentrisches Team von medizinischen Onkologen, Pathologen und Grundlagen- und Translationsforschern. Der Doktorand wird an der Graduiertenschule für Zellular- und Biomedizinische Wissenschaften der Universität Bern eingeschrieben.

## Tâches
• Établir, caractériser et maintenir des lignées de cellules cancéreuses et des organoïdes 3D dérivés du patient, y compris des modèles dérivés de biopsies tumorales fraîches
• Effectuer des études d'efficacité in vitro et des expériences de validation mécaniste en utilisant la réponse médicamenteuse, la croissance clonogène et des essais d'imagerie sur cellules vivantes
• Concevoir et réaliser des écrans de létalité synthétique CRISPR/Cas9 à l'échelle du génome et valider les résultats d'atteintes toxicologiques
• Analyser les données de dépistage et de séquençage à l'aide de pipelines de bioinformatique établis (MAGeCK RRA/MLE, R)
• Effectuer une microscopie par immunofluorescence confocale et multiplexée
• Contribuer aux expériences de xénogreffe in vivo et à la caractérisation histologique et computationnelle des tumeurs explantées
• Présenter les résultats des conférences nationales et internationales et préparer des manuscrits de premier auteur pour les revues évaluées par des pairs
• Participer au programme de doctorat de l'École supérieure des sciences cellulaires et biomédicales

## Votre profil
• Maîtrise (MSc) en sciences de la vie moléculaire (biologie cellulaire et moléculaire ou biochimie/biologie chimique), sciences biomédicales, biologie moléculaire, biochimie, biotechnologie ou un domaine connexe, complétée à la date de début, idéalement avec au moins une expérience de laboratoire complète.
• Expérience pratique solide dans la culture cellulaire des mammifères (l'expérience avec les organoïdes 3D est un avantage)
• Expérience en biologie moléculaire standard et en techniques d'imagerie (polarisation ouest, immunofluorescence, qPCR, microscopie optique). L'expérience de la microscopie confocale est un avantage
• Compétences de base dans l'analyse des données et les statistiques; la connaissance de GraphPad ou R est un avantage
• Une forte motivation pour la recherche translationnelle sur le cancer et un véritable intérêt pour le rapprochement des travaux de laboratoire et des questions cliniques
• Capacité de travailler en collaboration au sein d'une équipe interdisciplinaire et multicentrique
• Excellente maîtrise de l'anglais, écrit et parlé
Forte infrastructure de recherche et réseau international
Demande et contact

## Description du projet
Nos travaux de laboratoire se concentrent sur des stratégies de traitement moléculairement ciblées pour les tumeurs solides, exploitant les altérations de réparation de l'ADN comme vulnérabilités thérapeutiques pour faire progresser l'oncologie de précision. Dans des travaux antérieurs, à l'aide d'un écran CRISPR/Cas9 à l'échelle du génome et d'un écran médicamenteux à haut débit, nous avons récemment identifié Aurora kinase A (AURKA) comme une cible létale synthétique dans les cancers déficients en FANCA, le gène le plus souvent altéré de la voie de réparation de l'ADN de l'anémie Fanconi. Le projet de doctorat proposé permettra de faire progresser la validation préclinique de cette vulnérabilité nouvellement découverte dans des modèles de cancer cliniquement pertinents dérivés du patient et in vivo, d'identifier des cibles synergiques pour les combinaisons thérapeutiques par le biais d'un dépistage génomique fonctionnel et de caractériser le microenvironnement immunitaire tumoral des cancers déficients en voie de l'anémie Fanconi afin de proposer des cibles d'immunothérapie synergique. Le poste est intégré dans une équipe interdisciplinaire et multicentrique d'oncologues, de pathologistes et de chercheurs de base et de traducteurs. Le doctorant sera inscrit à l'École supérieure des sciences cellulaires et biomédicales de l'Université de Berne.

UniBE is quintessentially Bernese.
With us, you can expect a culture of respect and a healthy working environment.

## Areas of responsibility
The responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
• Leading and coordinating the veterinary team, including allocation of responsibilities, service planning, staff development and continuity of veterinary coverage across EAC facilities
• Managing and participating in veterinary facility rounds, including on-site visits
• Managing the Health Monitoring programs, vendor surveillance, and quarantine programs. Organizing the diagnostic and therapeutic measures in case of diseases and injuries in animals, aligned with their experimental purpose; implementing quarantine measures in case of outbreaks
• Centralizing and coordinating animal & bio-material imports, exports and transfers between EAC facilities including oversight of all documentation, shipment procedures, in collaboration with facility heads and teams, transport providers and the competent authorities
• Managing operations and control of the veterinary pharmacy and deputizing the clinical veterinarian
• Monitoring of pertinent quality reports and certificates
• Consulting scientists in experimental models' design and optimization (anesthesia, analgesia and post-operative care, imaging, 3Rs and culture of care)
• Ensuring regulatory compliance with internal guidelines, local and national regulations in collaboration with the AWOs and cantonal authorities
• Preparing Standard Operating procedures and guidelines relevant to all facilities
• Implementing consistent veterinary standards across facilities, reviewing their effectiveness and coordinating corrective actions
• Supporting education and training of personnel working with animals for procedures and database (pyrat)
• Participating into the Veterinary team education through seminars and Journal Club
• Providing on-call veterinary service during working time and participating in week-end shifts

## Requirements
• Degree in Veterinary Medicine and national license
• Five-year experience in the field with the relative species; laboratory fish (especially Danio rerio) experience very welcome
• Postgraduate specialisation in lab animal medicine
• ECLAM/ACLAM certification is a plus
• Fluency in English and German or commitment to learn it at a professional level
• Pro-active and goal-oriented attitude; capacity to present complex issues with the appropriate detail and clarity level, understanding the needs of all the various stakeholders (e.g. Veterinary Authorities, scientists)
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
• Interest in scientific dissemination and in implementing new ideas
Salary range according to the Univ. of Bern ranges, roughly 130K CHF / annum

## About us
The Experimental Animal Center (EAC) is the unit responsible for in vivo research at the University of Bern. The EAC accounts for over 15 animal facilities, serving 43 research institutes from the Faculties of Medicine, Science, and Veterinary Medicine (VetSuisse) and supports > 350 scientists performing in vivo research with mice, rats, rabbits, large mammals, fish, amphibians, and reptiles.
The EAC aims at providing optimal conditions for animal experimentation to achieve the best quality of basic, translational and clinical research involving animals. The 3Rs (Reduce, Refine, Replace), the “culture of care”, high quality, state-of-the-art veterinary support, and compliance to guidelines and regulations are cornerstones of the EAC strategy. To reach this goal, the EAC team accounts for a team of more than 50 between animal caretakers, infrastructure personnel, administration support, and veterinary team (including specialists accredited by ECLAM and ECVAA).

UniBE è quintessentialmente Bernese.
Con noi, ci si può aspettare una cultura del rispetto e un ambiente di lavoro sano.

## Aree di responsabilità
Le responsabilità includono, ma non sono limitate a:
• Guidare e coordinare il team veterinario, tra cui la ripartizione delle responsabilità, la pianificazione dei servizi, lo sviluppo del personale e la continuità della copertura veterinaria nelle strutture EAC
• Gestione e partecipazione a turni di impianti veterinari, comprese le visite in loco
• Gestione dei programmi di monitoraggio della salute, sorveglianza dei fornitori e programmi di quarantena. Organizzare le misure diagnostiche e terapeutiche in caso di malattie e lesioni negli animali, allineate con il loro scopo sperimentale; attuare misure di quarantena in caso di focolai
• Centralizzare e coordinare le importazioni, le esportazioni e i trasferimenti di animali e biomateriali tra strutture EAC, tra cui la supervisione di tutta la documentazione, le procedure di spedizione, in collaborazione con i responsabili delle strutture e i team, i fornitori di trasporti e le autorità competenti
• Gestione delle operazioni e controllo della farmacia veterinaria e deputazione del veterinario clinico
• Monitoraggio delle relazioni e dei certificati di qualità pertinenti
• Consulenza di scienziati nella progettazione e ottimizzazione dei modelli sperimentali (anestesia, analgesia e cura post-operativa, imaging, 3R e cultura della cura)
• Garantire il rispetto normativo delle linee guida interne, delle normative locali e nazionali in collaborazione con le AWO e le autorità cantonali
• Preparazione delle procedure operative standard e delle linee guida relative a tutte le strutture
• Implementare standard veterinari coerenti in tutte le strutture, rivedere la loro efficacia e coordinare le azioni correttive
• Sostegno all'istruzione e alla formazione del personale che lavora con gli animali per le procedure e il database (pyrat)
• Partecipare all'educazione del team veterinario attraverso seminari e Club Journal
• Fornire assistenza veterinaria durante l'orario di lavoro e partecipare a turni di fine settimana

## Requisiti
• Laurea in Medicina veterinaria e licenza nazionale
• Esperienza di cinque anni nel campo con le specie relative; pesci da laboratorio (soprattutto Danio rerio) esperienza molto gradita
• Specializzazione post-laurea in medicina animale da laboratorio
• La certificazione ECLAM/ACLAM è un plus
• Fluenza in inglese e tedesco o impegno per imparare a livello professionale
• Atteggiamento attivo e orientato verso l'obiettivo; capacità di presentare questioni complesse con il livello di dettaglio e chiarezza appropriato, comprensione delle esigenze di tutti i diversi stakeholder (ad esempio Autorità veterinari, scienziati)
• Eccellente capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione
• Interessi di diffusione scientifica e di attuazione di nuove idee
Gamma di insalata secondo la gamma Univ. di Berna, circa 130K CHF / annum
Applicazione e contatto
Il processo di selezione e le interviste procederanno su base regolare fino a quando la posizione sarà riempita.
Università di Berna
EAC
Murtenstrasse 46
3008 Berna
Riferimento: Capo del servizio veterinario
Con noi, crei valore.
Per te e per la società.

## Informazioni su di noi
Il Centro Sperimentale Animale (EAC) è l'unità responsabile della ricerca in vivo presso l'Università di Berna. L'AC rappresenta oltre 15 strutture animali, che servono 43 istituti di ricerca delle Facoltà di Medicina, Scienza e Medicina Veterinaria (VetSuisse) e supporta > 350 scienziati che eseguono ricerche in vivo con topi, ratti, conigli, grandi mammiferi, pesci, anfibi e rettili.
L'EAC mira a fornire condizioni ottimali per la sperimentazione animale per ottenere la migliore qualità della ricerca di base, traduttiva e clinica che coinvolge animali. I 3R (Ridurre, Raffinare, Sostituire), la “cultura della cura”, il supporto veterinario di alta qualità, all’avanguardia, e la conformità alle linee guida e ai regolamenti sono fondamentali della strategia EAC. Per raggiungere questo obiettivo, il team EAC rappresenta un team di oltre 50 addetti ai lavori, personale infrastrutturale, supporto amministrativo e team veterinario (inclusi specialisti accreditati da ECLAM e ECVAA).

jobs.description:
UniBE is ambitious.
With us, you deliver top performance and test your skills against the best.

## About the project
Chronic diseases often develop gradually over years, and their trajectories vary widely between individuals. Understanding this progression is key to early detection and timely intervention. Large multimodal health datasets combining medical imaging, wearable sensor data and clinical measurements now make it possible to study disease progression from multiple perspectives.
The goal of this project is to develop machine learning methods that learn from multimodal health data to characterise and model disease progression. Methodological focus areas the candidate may explore include:
• Multimodal representation learning across imaging, time series and tabular data
• Disease progression modelling from cross-sectional and sparse longitudinal data
• Causal machine learning to disentangle disease progression from treatment effects
• Learning with missing modalities and irregularly sampled signals
• Fairness and bias in multimodal models across demographic subgroups

## The candidate
We are looking for a curious and motivated PhD candidate with a keen interest in doing machine learning research in the healthcare space. You should hold a Master's degree in a quantitative discipline such as computer science, machine learning, statistics, biomedical or electrical engineering, or similar. You have solid knowledge of the foundations of machine learning, are willing to dig deep to understand a problem, and have strong analytical skills. You have practical experience implementing and evaluating machine learning models in Python. Experience processing biomedical data (imaging, wearable, tabular) is a plus.
Strong research infrastructure and international network
Application and Contact
Applications received by 30 November 2026 will receive full consideration. After the deadline, we may continue to review applications until the position is filled.
Applications should include your CV, full transcripts (BSc and MSc), and a cover letter (max 1 page) telling us about your motivation and something you are particularly proud of or passionate about.
Please only apply through the portal (use the apply button below). Applications via email will not be considered or forwarded to the submission system.
With us, you create value.
For yourself and for society.

## About us
You will be supervised by Prof. Dr. Lisa Koch, head of the Machine Learning in Medicine Lab (www.mlm-lab.ch). Our research group develops trustworthy machine learning towards clinical use. Our methodological interests include uncertainty quantification, robustness and reliability, representation learning, probabilistic modelling, and causal machine learning, with applications in biomedical imaging, wearable and tabular data. We publish at leading machine learning and medical imaging venues, collaborate closely with clinicians at Inselspital, Bern University Hospital, and maintain close links to research groups across Switzerland and internationally.
We are a small and collaborative team and value regular interactions. Bern offers a strong and growing medical AI community and an excellent quality of life.

## Informazioni sul progetto
Le malattie croniche spesso si sviluppano gradualmente nel corso degli anni, e le loro traiettorie variano ampiamente tra gli individui. Capire questa progressione è fondamentale per il rilevamento precoce e l'intervento tempestivo. I grandi dataset di salute multimodale che combinano immagini mediche, dati dei sensori indossabili e misurazioni cliniche ora permettono di studiare progressione della malattia da più prospettive.
L'obiettivo di questo progetto è quello di sviluppare metodi di apprendimento automatico che imparano dai dati sanitari multimodali per caratterizzare e modellare la progressione della malattia. Le aree di messa a fuoco metodologico che il candidato può esplorare includono:

## About the project
Chronic diseases often develop gradually over years, and their trajectories vary widely between individuals. Understanding this progression is key to early detection and timely intervention. Large multimodal health datasets combining medical imaging, wearable sensor data and clinical measurements now make it possible to study disease progression from multiple perspectives.
The goal of this project is to develop machine learning methods that learn from multimodal health data to characterise and model disease progression. Methodological focus areas the candidate may explore include:
• Multimodal representation learning across imaging, time series and tabular data
• Disease progression modelling from cross-sectional and sparse longitudinal data
• Causal machine learning to disentangle disease progression from treatment effects
• Learning with missing modalities and irregularly sampled signals
• Fairness and bias in multimodal models across demographic subgroups

## The candidate
We are looking for a curious and motivated PhD candidate with a keen interest in doing machine learning research in the healthcare space. You should hold a Master's degree in a quantitative discipline such as computer science, machine learning, statistics, biomedical or electrical engineering, or similar. You have solid knowledge of the foundations of machine learning, are willing to dig deep to understand a problem, and have strong analytical skills. You have practical experience implementing and evaluating machine learning models in Python. Experience processing biomedical data (imaging, wearable, tabular) is a plus.
Strong research infrastructure and international network
Application and Contact

Please only apply through the portal (use the apply button below). Applications via email will not be considered or forwarded to the submission system.

## About us
You will be supervised by Prof. Dr. Lisa Koch, head of the Machine Learning in Medicine Lab (www.mlm-lab.ch). Our research group develops trustworthy machine learning towards clinical use. Our methodological interests include uncertainty quantification, robustness and reliability, representation learning, probabilistic modelling, and causal machine learning, with applications in biomedical imaging, wearable and tabular data. We publish at leading machine learning and medical imaging venues, collaborate closely with clinicians at Inselspital, Bern University Hospital, and maintain close links to research groups across Switzerland and internationally.
We are a small and collaborative team and value regular interactions. Bern offers a strong and growing medical AI community and an excellent quality of life.

Chronische Krankheiten entwickeln sich oft allmählich über Jahre, und ihre Trajektorien variieren stark zwischen Individuen. • Multimodales Repräsentationslernen über Bildgebung, Zeitreihen und Tabellendaten
• Krankheitsprogressionsmodellierung aus Querschnitts- und spärlichen Längsschnittdaten
• Kausales maschinelles Lernen, um Krankheitsprogression von Behandlungseffekten zu entwirren

• Fairness und Bias in multimodalen Modellen über demografische Untergruppen hinweg

## A propos du projet
Les maladies chroniques se développent souvent progressivement au fil des ans, et leurs trajectoires varient grandement d'un individu à l'autre. La compréhension de cette progression est essentielle à la détection précoce et à l'intervention rapide. De grands ensembles de données multimodales sur la santé combinant l'imagerie médicale, les données de capteurs portables et les mesures cliniques permettent désormais d'étudier la progression de la maladie sous de multiples perspectives.
L'objectif de ce projet est de développer des méthodes d'apprentissage automatique qui apprennent à partir de données de santé multimodales pour caractériser et modéliser la progression des maladies. Les domaines d'intérêt méthodologiques que le candidat peut explorer comprennent :
• Apprentissage de la représentation multimodale à travers l'imagerie, les séries chronologiques et les données tabulaires
• Modélisation de la progression de la maladie à partir de données longitudinales transversales et éparses
• Apprentissage automatique causal pour démêler la progression de la maladie des effets du traitement
• Apprendre avec des modalités manquantes et des signaux échantillonnés irrégulièrement
• Équité et biais dans les modèles multimodaux des sous-groupes démographiques

## Le candidat
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un candidat au doctorat curieux et motivé qui s'intéresse vivement à la recherche en apprentissage automatique dans l'espace des soins de santé. Vous devriez détenir une maîtrise dans une discipline quantitative comme l'informatique, l'apprentissage automatique, les statistiques, le génie biomédical ou électrique, ou similaire. Vous avez une solide connaissance des fondements de l'apprentissage automatique, êtes prêt à creuser profondément pour comprendre un problème, et avez de solides compétences analytiques. Vous avez une expérience pratique de mise en œuvre et d'évaluation de modèles d'apprentissage automatique en Python. jobs.description:
UniBE is interconnected.
With us, you're part of an international community and benefit from interdisciplinary collaboration.

## Tasks & 
• Requirements
We are looking for a motivated postdoctoral researcher who will lead the bioinformatic analyses of ancient plant DNA datasets. You will develop and adapt advanced bioinformatic tools and pipelines for individual-based ancient DNA (aDNA) data, as well as sedimentary ancient DNA (sedaDNA) metabarcoding and metagenomics. You will use these approaches to reconstruct changes in genetic diversity through time and investigate the genetic basis of adaptation to past environmental change. Furthermore, you will integrate paleogenomic data with population genetic models to test competing hypotheses about postglacial range expansion and demographic change in European tree species. You will collaborate with an interdisciplinary research team, provide scientific guidance to PhD and MSc students, present your findings at international conferences, and publish your results in leading peer-reviewed scientific journals.
You hold a PhD in bioinformatics, computational biology, biology, or a related discipline and have a strong interest in applying computational methods to evolutionary and ecological questions. Substantial experience in bioinformatics, next-generation sequencing (NGS) data analysis, and ancient DNA research is essential. Programming skills (e.g. Python and R), as well as experience with command-line tools and high-performance computing clusters are expected. Knowledge of population genetics, paleoecology, molecular biology, or vegetation ecology is an asset. You approach your work with precision, creativity, and reliability, and have strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills. A proven track record of scientific publications and an excellent command of English are expected.

jobs.description:
UniBE is interconnected.
With us, you're part of an international community and benefit from interdisciplinary collaboration.

## Objective
The main objective of ESA's Genesis mission is to realize an ultra-stable, global Earth-fixed coordinate system (aiming for 1 mm accuracy and 0.1 mm/year stability necessary to monitor climate change relevant processes). The Genesis satellite will combine the four space geodetic techniques, Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS, like GPS), Satellite Laser Ranging (SLR), Doppler Orbitography and Radiopositioning Integrated by Satellite (DORIS), and Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI), on a highly calibrated and stable platform. The adequate
analysis of these mission data requires significant upgrades and developments in scientific software packages, like for instance the Bernese GNSS Software maintained and used at AIUB.
The position of the Senior Research Assistant is scheduled for two years and will coordinate the significant amount of software modifications, that need to be done in parallel. In this context, the development environment and process used at AIUB shall be reviewed and advanced where necessary. In the frame of this project a number of decisions have to be taken (regarding, e.g., software design, data handling, High Performance Computing, HPC), where professional input from a software engineer is welcome. The activities will also include contacts to external partner institutions such as the Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie (BKG), Germany, the Research Institute of Geodesy, Cartography and Topography (VUGTK), Czech Republic, and the
Technical University of Munich (TUM), Germany. The planned developments will be performed in close exchange with ESA's Genesis Science Exploitation Team and the IAG/IERS Joint Working Group, where IAG is the International Association of Geodesy and IERS stands for International Earth Rotation and Reference Systems Service.

## Education
The candidate is expected to have successfully completed a Master or Ph.D. thesis in computer science, astronomy, geodesy, physics, or a related topic. Experience in software engineering (we use modern Fortran, C++, Python, and Perl) is mandatory, a background in space geodetic data analyses, ideally using the Bernese GNSS Software package, is beneficial. The candidate should speak and write English fluently.
The candidate should start working in Bern as soon as possible.
The position is scheduled for two years with an option for an extension to three years. The salary follows the guidelines of the University of Bern and depends on the qualification of the successful candidate.

UniBE is interconnected.
With us, you're part of an international community and benefit from interdisciplinary collaboration.

## Objective
The main objective of ESA's Genesis mission is to realize an ultra-stable, global Earth-fixed coordinate system (aiming for 1 mm accuracy and 0.1 mm/year stability necessary to monitor climate change relevant processes). The Genesis satellite will combine the four space geodetic techniques, Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS, like GPS), Satellite Laser Ranging (SLR), Doppler Orbitography and Radiopositioning Integrated by Satellite (DORIS), and Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI), on a highly calibrated and stable platform. The adequate
analysis of these mission data requires significant upgrades and developments in scientific software packages, like for instance the Bernese GNSS Software maintained and used at AIUB.
The position of the Senior Research Assistant is scheduled for two years and will coordinate the significant amount of software modifications, that need to be done in parallel. In this context, the development environment and process used at AIUB shall be reviewed and advanced where necessary. In the frame of this project a number of decisions have to be taken (regarding, e.g., software design, data handling, High Performance Computing, HPC), where professional input from a software engineer is welcome. The activities will also include contacts to external partner institutions such as the Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie (BKG), Germany, the Research Institute of Geodesy, Cartography and Topography (VUGTK), Czech Republic, and the
Technical University of Munich (TUM), Germany. The planned developments will be performed in close exchange with ESA's Genesis Science Exploitation Team and the IAG/IERS Joint Working Group, where IAG is the International Association of Geodesy and IERS stands for International Earth Rotation and Reference Systems Service.

## Education
The candidate is expected to have successfully completed a Master or Ph.D. thesis in computer science, astronomy, geodesy, physics, or a related topic. Experience in software engineering (we use modern Fortran, C++, Python, and Perl) is mandatory, a background in space geodetic data analyses, ideally using the Bernese GNSS Software package, is beneficial. The candidate should speak and write English fluently.
The candidate should start working in Bern as soon as possible.
The position is scheduled for two years with an option for an extension to three years. The salary follows the guidelines of the University of Bern and depends on the qualification of the successful candidate.

L'analyse de ces données de mission nécessite des mises à niveau et des développements importants dans les progiciels scientifiques, comme par exemple le logiciel GNSS bernois entretenu et utilisé à l'AIUB.

UniBE is quintessentially Bernese.
With us, you can expect a culture of respect and a healthy working environment.

## 
• Your profile
The future position holder brings several years of experience in leadership roles within a large, interdisciplinary university emergency medicine department and has extensive clinical experience in emergency medicine, shock room management, and polytrauma management. She or he is expected to represent the specialty with excellence in clinical practice, research, and teaching, and to integrate, strengthen, and further develop academic emergency medicine in clinical practice, in undergraduate, graduate, and continuing education, as well as in research.
The position is to be filled by an internationally recognized and well-connected candidate with a proven research track record in clinical emergency medicine, a talent for innovation, and a strong interdisciplinary and interprofessional orientation. Regular publication activity and a successful record of securing competitive external funding are required.
You are an outstanding emergency medicine physician with a proven field of expertise within clinical emergency medicine. You hold a recognized board certification in a field relevant to clinical emergency medicine (e.g., general internal medicine, anesthesiology, critical care medicine, or surgery) as well as a specialization in clinical emergency medicine (SIWF) or an internationally equivalent qualification. In addition, you have an understanding of the Swiss healthcare system (including the continuing medical education system) and the scope and competencies of medical specialties in Switzerland. You aim to establish a strong local and regional network with referring physicians.
Management, leadership, and organizational experience at the university, interdisciplinary, and interprofessional levels, along with relevant knowledge of business administration and health systems are essential. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are expected. You have a good command of German and French or are willing to learn these languages. In addition, you are actively committed to implementing measures related to equal opportunity and diversity.
A habilitation or equivalent academic qualification is required. In addition, candidates are expected to demonstrate innovative and interprofessional teaching and learning approaches, as well as a strong commitment to supporting early-career faculty and promoting equal opportunity.

## Self-conception
The University of Bern is committed to equal opportunity, diversity, and inclusion, and strives to ensure a diverse workforce. It welcomes applications from people of all genders and strongly encourages qualified female researchers in particular to apply. The University of Bern offers various programs to balance work and family/personal life. These include, among other things, childcare options, support for partners, and the possibility of job sharing (https://www.vereinbarkeit.unibe.ch/index_eng.html). Applications for job sharing are welcome; please submit a joint proposal outlining your plan for collaboration.

UniBE è quintessentialmente Bernese.
Con noi, ci si può aspettare una cultura del rispetto e un ambiente di lavoro sano.

##
• Il tuo profilo
Il futuro titolare della posizione porta diversi anni di esperienza in ruoli di leadership all'interno di un ampio e interdisciplinare dipartimento di medicina di emergenza universitaria e ha una vasta esperienza clinica in medicina di emergenza, gestione degli spazi di shock e gestione dei politrauma. Lei o lui dovrebbe rappresentare la specialità con l'eccellenza nella pratica clinica, la ricerca, e l'insegnamento, e di integrare, rafforzare e sviluppare ulteriormente medicina di emergenza accademica nella pratica clinica, in laurea, laurea, e formazione continua, così come nella ricerca.
La posizione è di essere riempita da un candidato riconosciuto a livello internazionale e ben collegato con un comprovato record di ricerca in medicina di emergenza clinica, un talento per l'innovazione, e un forte orientamento interdisciplinare e interprofessionale. Sono necessarie regolari attività di pubblicazione e un record di successo per garantire un finanziamento esterno competitivo.
Sei un medico di emergenza eccezionale con un campo di esperienza comprovato all'interno di medicina di emergenza clinica. Lei possiede una certificazione di bordo riconosciuta in un campo rilevante per la medicina di emergenza clinica (ad esempio, medicina interna generale, anestesiologia, medicina di cura critica, o chirurgia) nonché una specializzazione in medicina di emergenza clinica (SIWF) o una qualifica equivalente a livello internazionale. Inoltre, avete una comprensione del sistema sanitario svizzero (compreso il sistema di educazione medica continua) e la portata e le competenze delle specialità mediche in Svizzera. Si mira a stabilire una forte rete locale e regionale con medici di riferimento.
La gestione, la leadership e l'esperienza organizzativa a livello universitario, interdisciplinare e interprofessionale, insieme alla conoscenza rilevante dell'amministrazione aziendale e dei sistemi sanitari sono essenziali. Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali sono attesi. Avete un buon comando di tedesco e francese o siete disposti a imparare queste lingue. Inoltre, si è attivamente impegnati a implementare misure relative alla pari opportunità e diversità.
È richiesta una abilitazione o una qualifica accademica equivalente. Inoltre, i candidati sono tenuti a dimostrare approcci innovativi e interprofessionali di insegnamento e apprendimento, nonché un forte impegno a sostenere la facoltà di assistenza precoce e promuovere la parità di opportunità.

## Autoconcezione
L'Università di Berna si impegna a pari opportunità, diversità e inclusione, e si sforza di garantire una forza lavoro diversificata. Accoglie con favore le applicazioni di persone di tutti i generi e incoraggia fortemente i ricercatori femminili qualificati in particolare per applicare. L'Università di Berna offre vari programmi per bilanciare il lavoro e la vita familiare/personale. Questi includono, tra l'altro, opzioni di assistenza all'infanzia, supporto per i partner, e la possibilità di condivisione del lavoro (https://www.vereinbarkeit.unibe.ch/index eng.html). Le domande di condivisione del lavoro sono benvenute; si prega di presentare una proposta comune che delinea il vostro piano di collaborazione.

Sie sind ein herausragender Notarzt mit einem ausgewiesenen Fachgebiet in der klinischen Notfallmedizin. Sie besitzen eine anerkannte Vorstandszertifizierung in einem für die klinische Notfallmedizin relevanten Bereich (z.B. allgemeine Innere Medizin, Anästhesiologie, Intensivmedizin oder Chirurgie) sowie eine Spezialisierung in klinischer Notfallmedizin (SIWF) oder eine international gleichwertige Qualifikation. Darüber hinaus haben Sie ein Verständnis für das Schweizer Gesundheitssystem (einschließlich der medizinischen Weiterbildung) und den Umfang und die Kompetenzen der medizinischen Fachrichtungen in der Schweiz. Sie wollen ein starkes lokales und regionales Netzwerk mit überweisenden Ärzten aufbauen.
Management-, Führungs- und Organisationserfahrung auf universitärer, interdisziplinärer und interprofessioneller Ebene sowie relevante Kenntnisse der Betriebswirtschaft und der Gesundheitssysteme sind unerlässlich. Hervorragende Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten werden erwartet. Sie beherrschen Deutsch und Französisch oder sind bereit, diese Sprachen zu lernen. Darüber hinaus engagieren Sie sich aktiv für die Umsetzung von Maßnahmen im Zusammenhang mit Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt.
Eine Habilitation oder eine gleichwertige akademische Qualifikation ist erforderlich. Darüber hinaus wird von den Kandidaten erwartet, dass sie innovative und interprofessionelle Lehr- und Lernansätze sowie ein starkes Engagement für die Unterstützung der frühkindlichen Fakultät und die Förderung der Chancengleichheit demonstrieren.

Zudem verfügen Sie über ein Verständnis des schweizerischen Gesundheitswesens (inkl. Weiterbildungssystem) und des Spektrums/der Kompetenzen der medizinischen Fächer der Schweiz. Sie streben eine gute loko-regionale Vernetzung mit den Zuweisern an.
Management-, Führungs- und Organisationserfahrung auf universitärer, interdisziplinärer und interprofessioneller Ebene mit entsprechenden betriebswirtschaftlichen und gesundheitssystemischen Kenntnissen sind unerlässlich. Exzellente kommunikative und soziale Kompetenzen werden erwartet. Sie verfügen über gute Deutsch- und Französischkenntnisse oder bringen die Bereitschaft mit, diese zu erwerben. Zudem setzen Sie sich aktiv für die Umsetzung von Massnahmen für Chancengleichheits- und Diversity ein.
Die Habilitation oder ein gleichwertiger akademischer Leistungsausweis wird vorausgesetzt. Des Weiteren wird der Nachweis innovativer und interprofessioneller Lehr- und Lernkonzepte sowie ein starkes Engagement in der Nachwuchsförderung und Chancengleichheit erwartet.

## Selbstverständnis
Die Universität Bern engagiert sich für Chancengleichheit, Diversität und Inklusion und strebt eine vielfältige Zusammensetzung ihrer Mitarbeitenden an. Sie begrüsst Bewerbungen von Personen aller Geschlechter und ermutigt insbesondere qualifizierte Wissenschaftlerinnen nachdrücklich sich zu bewerben. Die Universität Bern verfügt über verschiedene Angebote im Bereich Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie/Partnerschaft. Hierzu gehören unter anderem Kinderbetreuungsangebote, Angebote für Partnerinnen und Partner und die Möglichkeit des Jobsharings (https://www.vereinbarkeit.unibe.ch). Le nouveau titulaire apporte plusieurs années d'expérience dans les fonctions exécutives dans une médecine d'urgence interdisciplinaire plus grande et possède une vaste expérience clinique en médecine d'urgence, salle de choc et polytrauma. ## Über uns
Das Institut für Sozial- und Präventivmedizin (ISPM) an der Universität Bern ist in der Forschung, Dienstleistung sowie der Lehre der öffentlichen Gesundheit, klinischen Epidemiologie, Biostatistik und der internationalen Umweltgesundheit aktiv. www.ispm.unibe.ch
In der Schweiz leben schätzungsweise eine halbe Million Menschen mit einer seltenen Krankheit. ## Informazioni su di noi
L'Istituto di Medicina Sociale e Preventiva (ISPM) dell'Università di Berna è attivo nella ricerca, nel servizio e nell'insegnamento della salute pubblica, dell'epidemiologia clinica, della biostatistica e della salute ambientale internazionale. www.ispm.unibe.ch
In Svizzera, circa mezzo milione di persone vivono con una malattia rara. Tuttavia, i dati disponibili a livello nazionale sulle diagnosi, i corsi di malattia, le terapie e le esigenze di coloro che sono interessati sono ancora carenti. Ma è proprio questa informazione che è fondamentale per migliorare la cura e promuovere la ricerca in modo mirato. Qui entra il registro svizzero delle malattie rare. Sotto la direzione del Prof. Dr. Med. Claudia Kuehni collabora con ospedali, organizzazioni dei pazienti, Orphanet Svizzera e kosek per costruire questa base di dati. Il registro crea importanti basi per la cura e la ricerca. In futuro, dovrebbe consentire studi e rendere più facile per coloro che sono interessati a partecipare a progetti di ricerca.

Exciting work in a dynamic team closely networked with research and services

## About us
The Institute of Social and Preventive Medicine (ISPM) at the University of Bern is active in research, service and the teaching of public health, clinical epidemiology, biostatistics and international environmental health. www.ispm.unibe.ch
In Switzerland, an estimated half a million people live with a rare disease. Nevertheless, nationally available data on diagnoses, disease courses, therapies and the needs of those affected are still lacking. But it is precisely this information that is crucial for improving care and advancing research in a targeted manner. This is where the Swiss Register for Rare Diseases comes in. Under the direction of Prof. Dr. med. Claudia Kuehni works together with hospitals, patient organisations, Orphanet Switzerland and kosek to build this data base. The register creates important foundations for care and research. In the future, it should enable studies and make it easier for those affected to participate in research projects.

## The Challenge
We are offering a PhD position to a highly motivated student. The research project investigates the impact of biomechanical stimulation, recreating the mechanical environment of bone tissue under physiological and dental surgical conditions, on cell-cell and cell-matrix interactions involved in early bone healing events. The project will utilize a variety of cell and molecular biological techniques to investigate molecular interactions that provide instructive cues for osteogenesis and osseointegration, with the aim of supporting personalized treatment approaches in dental implantology.

• Master's degree in Cell or Molecular Biology. Candidates with a Master's degree in Dental Medicine will also be considered.
• Previous experience in cell culture techniques (primary and immortalized cells), as well as cell and molecular biological methods, is a strong asset.
• Additional experience in genomics, bioinformatics, imaging, and related image-analysis technologies is advantageous but not required.
• Excellent command of written and spoken English.
• Ability to work both under supervision and independently, while contributing to a collaborative team environment.

Wir bieten einer hochmotivierten Person eine Doktoratsstelle an. jobs.description:
UniBE is prestigious.
With us, you benefit from the excellent reputation of a long-standing institution all around the world.

## What You Will Do
• Establish and characterise ATP- and NAD(P)H-dependent reaction networks and couple them to metabolic and biosynthetic processes, such as cell-free protein synthesis
• Purify and reconstitute membrane proteins into liposomes and GUVs
• Characterise kinetics, stability and energetic efficiency using spectroscopic techniques and fluorescence microscopy, and support this with quantitative modelling
• Collaborate closely with the Stavrakis/deMello group at ETH Zürich on microfluidic vesicle production and apply these technologies at the University of Bern

## Requirements
• MSc degree in biochemistry, molecular biology, biophysics, biotechnology or a related field
• Experience in protein purification, enzymology, membrane proteins, cell-free systems, fluorescence microscopy or kinetic modelling is beneficial
• Strong interest in quantitative biochemistry, bioenergetics and synthetic biology
• Ability to work in an interdisciplinary, collaborative environment
• Good communication skills in English
Structured doctoral training within the Graduate School of Cellular and Biomedical Sciences (GCB)
Application and Contact
Please submit your application including a CV, Bachelor and Master certificates and transcripts, and a letter of motivation as a single PDF by 20.11.2026. Please note that applications must be submitted through the online application portal.
With us, you create value.
For yourself and for society.

## Project Description
Bottom-up synthetic biology aims to build cell-like systems from defined molecular components. A key challenge is energy: living cells require a continuous supply of ATP and NAD(P)H to drive metabolism, biosynthesis and transport, and any synthetic cell needs the same.
The von Ballmoos group is an ambitious and interdisciplinary team that has been pioneering different ATP regeneration modules that mimic oxidative phosphorylation and photophosphorylation by co-reconstitution of relevant proteins into liposomes. Combined with enzymatic NADH regeneration, these modules can already power ATP- and NADH-dependent enzyme cascades in vitro.
Building on this, the PhD project aims to couple our energy and cofactor regeneration modules to cell-like metabolic pathways, including biosynthetic reactions such as protein production, and to understand how such coupled systems can be maintained and controlled over time. Selected reaction networks will then be encapsulated into giant unilamellar vesicles (GUVs) to create increasingly cell-like systems.
The position is embedded in a four-year SNSF project jointly awarded to the von Ballmoos group and the Stavrakis/deMello group at ETH Zürich, which develops microfluidic technologies for the generation and manipulation of synthetic vesicles. The PhD student will be part of a team working on complementary aspects of the project across both institutions.
Beyond fundamental questions, the project will design these systems with applications in mind: as self-sustaining compartments for the sustainable production of fine chemicals, or as programmable artificial cells for biomedical use.

## Descrizione del progetto
La biologia sintetica di fondo mira a costruire sistemi cellulari da componenti molecolari definiti. Una sfida chiave è l'energia: le cellule viventi richiedono una fornitura continua di ATP e NAD (P)H per guidare il metabolismo, la biosintesi e il trasporto, e qualsiasi cellula sintetica ha bisogno della stessa.
Il gruppo von Ballmoos è un team ambizioso e interdisciplinare che è stato pionieristico diversi moduli di rigenerazione ATP che imitano la fosforilazione ossidativa e la fotofosforilazione mediante co-ricostituzione di proteine rilevanti in liposomi. Combinati con la rigenerazione enzimatica NADH, questi moduli possono già alimentare le cascate di enzimi ATP- e NADH in vitro.
Basandosi su questo, il progetto PhD mira a accoppiare i nostri moduli di rigenerazione di energia e cofattore a vie metaboliche simili alle cellule, comprese le reazioni biosintetiche come la produzione di proteine, e per capire come tali sistemi accoppiati possono essere mantenuti e controllati nel tempo. Le reti di reazione selezionate saranno quindi incapsulate in vescicole unilamellari giganti (GUV) per creare sistemi sempre più simili alle cellule.
La posizione è incorporata in un progetto SNSF di quattro anni congiuntamente assegnato al gruppo von Ballmoos e al gruppo Stavrakis/deMello di ETH Zürich, che sviluppa tecnologie microfluidici per la generazione e la manipolazione di vescicole sintetiche. Lo studente del dottorato sarà parte di un team che si occupa di aspetti complementari del progetto in entrambe le istituzioni.
Oltre alle questioni fondamentali, il progetto progetta questi sistemi con applicazioni in mente: come scomparti autosufficienti per la produzione sostenibile di prodotti chimici fini, o come celle artificiali programmabili per uso biomedico.

UniBE is prestigious.
With us, you benefit from the excellent reputation of a long-standing institution all around the world.

## What You Will Do
• Establish and characterise ATP- and NAD(P)H-dependent reaction networks and couple them to metabolic and biosynthetic processes, such as cell-free protein synthesis
• Purify and reconstitute membrane proteins into liposomes and GUVs
• Characterise kinetics, stability and energetic efficiency using spectroscopic techniques and fluorescence microscopy, and support this with quantitative modelling
• Collaborate closely with the Stavrakis/deMello group at ETH Zürich on microfluidic vesicle production and apply these technologies at the University of Bern

## Requirements
• MSc degree in biochemistry, molecular biology, biophysics, biotechnology or a related field
• Experience in protein purification, enzymology, membrane proteins, cell-free systems, fluorescence microscopy or kinetic modelling is beneficial
• Strong interest in quantitative biochemistry, bioenergetics and synthetic biology
• Ability to work in an interdisciplinary, collaborative environment
• Good communication skills in English
Structured doctoral training within the Graduate School of Cellular and Biomedical Sciences (GCB)
Application and Contact
Please submit your application including a CV, Bachelor and Master certificates and transcripts, and a letter of motivation as a single PDF by 20.11.2026. Please note that applications must be submitted through the online application portal.
With us, you create value.
For yourself and for society.

## Project Description
Bottom-up synthetic biology aims to build cell-like systems from defined molecular components. A key challenge is energy: living cells require a continuous supply of ATP and NAD(P)H to drive metabolism, biosynthesis and transport, and any synthetic cell needs the same.
The von Ballmoos group is an ambitious and interdisciplinary team that has been pioneering different ATP regeneration modules that mimic oxidative phosphorylation and photophosphorylation by co-reconstitution of relevant proteins into liposomes. Combined with enzymatic NADH regeneration, these modules can already power ATP- and NADH-dependent enzyme cascades in vitro.
Building on this, the PhD project aims to couple our energy and cofactor regeneration modules to cell-like metabolic pathways, including biosynthetic reactions such as protein production, and to understand how such coupled systems can be maintained and controlled over time. Selected reaction networks will then be encapsulated into giant unilamellar vesicles (GUVs) to create increasingly cell-like systems.
The position is embedded in a four-year SNSF project jointly awarded to the von Ballmoos group and the Stavrakis/deMello group at ETH Zürich, which develops microfluidic technologies for the generation and manipulation of synthetic vesicles. The PhD student will be part of a team working on complementary aspects of the project across both institutions.
Beyond fundamental questions, the project will design these systems with applications in mind: as self-sustaining compartments for the sustainable production of fine chemicals, or as programmable artificial cells for biomedical use.

UniBE is ambitious.
With us, you deliver top performance and test your skills against the best.

## 
• Profile
We are looking for a creative and motivated candidate, a team player, with a MSc degree in physics or engineering. Prior expertise in optics is an asset and a basic understanding of polarisation is a plus. Excellent oral and written skills in English are a requirement.

## 
• What we offer
The position is based at the Centre for Space and Habitability, which strives to investigate key questions in space sciences through interdisciplinarity. Our team collaborates tightly with the Microbiology Laboratory (Prof. Pilar Junier) of the University of Neuchâtel where the lab measurements are conducted. The city of Bern is well known for its quality of life, cultural richness and beautiful surroundings offering plenty of opportunities for outdoor activities.
The position is funded for a period of 4 years. The annual gross salary is competitive, ranging from CHF 50,042 in the first year to CHF 53,263 in the final year. Ample funding for travel, publications and computing resources will be available. Child allowance and maternity/paternity leave are offered. Assistance with visa procedures is available for international candidates. Additionally, the CSH offers career advice, mentorship, and teaching opportunities.
International reputation
With us, you create value.
For yourself and for society.

## NCCR Genesis: background
The Centre for Space and Habitability (CSH) at the University of Bern invites applications for a PhD position in the frame of the new NCCR Genesis.
The National Centre of Competence in Research NCCR Genesis is a research infrastructure project funded by SNSF focussing on exploring the emergence of life in the Universe. This interdisciplinary research infrastructure brings together physicists, earth and planetary scientists, chemists and biologists to understand the conditions and the mechanisms that enable life to emerge. Developing reliable methods to detect unambiguous traces of life (biosignatures) – whether through remote sensing or direct onsite measurements – requires significant innovation. These challenges demand close collaboration across physics, biology, chemistry and the earth sciences. NCCR Genesis does not aim to provide answers in all fields, but to drive innovative research and achieve decisive progress.
Details on NCCR Genesis are available on its website https://nccr-genesis.ch.
Our commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion
NCCR Genesis is deeply committed to equality, diversity and inclusion. Our aim is to cultivate a respectful and fair work culture with equal access to professional development and support for all. We strongly encourage applications from under-represented groups.
Project description
Are we alone in the universe? The search for life beyond the Earth is one of the most fascinating endeavours that humankind has embarked upon. Recent years have seen tremendous progress in instrumentation, laboratory experiments and theories on the origin of life.
This PhD project will investigate the impact of icy-moon environmental conditions on the detectability of selected bacteria in ice/salt mixtures rapidly exposed to vacuum, extremely low temperatures and high-radiation levels. For this purpose, a high-sensitivity spectro-polarimeter will be interfaced with a temperature-vacuum chamber. Additionally, an electron gun and a UV light source will be used to investigate the incidence of harsh conditions on bacterial samples deposited on ice as a proxy for icy moon conditions. The study will also investigate whether spectro-polarimetry could probe fundamental structures in the microorganisms such as cofactors or proteins in the near UV. The project will thus investigate the detectability of fundamental biosignatures relevant to a wider range of microorganisms. This effort will inform the preparation of future life-detection missions in our Solar System, such as the planned ESA L4 mission to Enceladus.
The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary team (lead: Prof. Brice-Olivier Demory) with expertise spanning astrophysics, microbiology, biomedicine and engineering. The new group member will have the opportunity to gain unique experience in dual-use instrumentation applicable to both space exploration and medical diagnostics.
